verdict.rationale: A probe confirms llms.txt is live at support.claude.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and that docs are also available as clean markdown (.md) files, both of which are agent-consumable formats an AI agent could be pointed at. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt content specifically indexes Claude Design's own docs/pages (it shows generic Help Center topics) and independent confirmation that agents actually use these sources successfully.
